items.source:
Verify that the actual URI is equal to the URI built using the given uriTemplate and uriVars. Example: 
// Verify that uri is equal to "/orders/1/items/2"
assertThat(uri).isEqualToTemplate("/orders/{orderId}/items/{itemId}", 1, 2));
items.translation:
验证实际 URI 是否等于使用给定的 uriTemplate 和 uriVars 构建的 URI。 示例：
// 验证 uri 是否等于 "/orders/1/items/2"
assertThat(uri).isEqualToTemplate("/orders/{orderId}/items/{itemId}", 1, 2));

items.source:
Verify that the actual URI matches the given Ant-style uriPattern. Example: 
// Verify that pattern matches "/orders/1/items/2"
assertThat(uri).matchPattern("/orders/*"));
items.translation:
验证实际 URI 是否与给定的 Ant 风格 uriPattern 匹配。 示例：
// Verify that pattern matches "/orders/1/items/2"
assertThat(uri).matchPattern("/orders/*"));

items.source: Verify that the actual URI matches the given Ant-style uriPattern.
items.translation: 验证实际 URI 是否与给定的 Ant 风格 uriPattern 匹配。

items.source: uriTemplate - the expected URI string, with a number of URI template variables
items.translation: uriTemplate - 预期的 URI 字符串，包含多个 URI 模板变量

items.source: uriVars - the values to replace the URI template variables
items.translation: uriVars - 用于替换 URI 模板变量的值

items.source: uriPattern - the pattern that is expected to match
AssertJ assertions that can be applied to a String representing a URI.
items.translation: AssertJ 可应用于表示 URI 的 String 的 assertions。
